'''Gorgs''', known as '''chubas''' in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], were small precocious amphibians that could be found on several planets, from the swamps of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="SWG" />  to the deserts of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Field Guide" /> (the latter being their original native planet). They were popularly favored as food by many humanoid species (including on Tatooine), either dried, fricasseed, or roasted in [[Manak leaf|manak leaves]]. In Huttese, "hot chubas" were called "hotsa chuba."

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Gorg_tongue.png|thumb|left|250px|Gorgs had long tongues]]
There were many species of gorgs, including long-tailed, three-eyed, and four-eyed varieties. Different types of gorgs were eventually introduced to the populations of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and its moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], where they evolved to become large, flesh-eating creatures.

Sometimes, during times of great drought on their native world of Tatooine, gorgs hibernated in burrows, encasing themselves in a cocoon of hardened saliva. Occasionally, these burrows that gorgs used for general shelter and hibernation could be within [[Profogg/Legends|profogg]] "towns".<ref name="Field Guide">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

Natural predators included [[Worrt/Legends|worrts]], which the gorgs themselves were somewhat similar to, but smaller and more ambulatory.<ref name="Field Guide" />

Gorgs were also known to be [[Mutant|mutated]] by bio-engineers. One such mutation resulted in the successful growth of a [[chubafly]]: a colorful gorg but with wings that made it capable of flying.<ref name="SWG:NGE">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Gorgs in the Galaxy==
[[File:Gorg_db.jpg|thumb|right|180px|A gorg for sale in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]]]]
Gorg eggs were edible and were used, poached, as an ingredient in [["Hungry Hutt" breakfast sandwich]]es on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]. Gorgs on Tatooine could be found in three places: [[Profogg/Legends|profogg]] burrows, encased in their hardened saliva cocoons; sewers, where harvesters bred them illegally; and [[Gorgmonger/Legends|gorgmonger]] farms.

Gorgmongers, such as Tatooine's [[Gragra/Legends|Gragra]] the female [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]], would root a gorg pod in an amniotic-like fluid and feed it a variety of things, including [[Funnel flower/Legends|funnel flowers]], [[razor moss]]&mdash;or even raw sewage. Soon, the specimen would lay eggs, which would then hatch into tadpoles after several days. The gorgmonger would then separate these hatchlings from the adult (as adult gorgs will devour their young) and raise them to maturity. Only then could the amphibians be sold in the bazaar or marketplace.

==History==
When [[Gragra/Legends|Gragra]] left [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] to work elsewhere, this caused the gorg population in the sewers to grow considerably over the following years. Homeless people often fed on these gorgs.<ref name="SWG:EtGE" />

[[File:Longtailfrog.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jabba the Hutt consumed gorgs live]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]&mdash;just out of curiosity&mdash;the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] fetched a gorg with his tongue from [[Gragra/Legends|Gragra's]] booth at the market of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and was told he would have to pay seven [[Wupiupi/Legends|wupiupi]] for it. Shocked at the cost, Binks spat the gorg out, inadvertently ruining [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba's]] meal in the process and nearly being beaten to a pulp by an enraged Sebulba until [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] broke up the fight.

Gorgs were a favored food of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. At the beginning of the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], Jabba bit off a gorg's head and spat it at a gong, signaling the start of the race.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Byxle Pedette]], the chef and owner of the [[Tasty Dried Critters]] franchise, employed [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to deliver gorgs. Yet the gorgs would often be delivered alive, much to the shock of the customer.<ref name="SWG:TDC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Tasty Dried Critters|Tatooine}}</ref>
